04 Method

Good software starts before the first line of code.

  1. 01

    Understand

    Find the actual problem. Remove assumptions.

  2. 02

    Design

    Reduce unnecessary complexity. Make the path obvious.

  3. 03

    Build

    Ship the smallest useful system.

  4. 04

    Test

    Break it before users do. Fix what matters.

  5. 05

    Iterate

    Use feedback as the next specification.
